A strictly totally positive 2x2 Laplace-kernel minor implies C12 C23-C13 C22>0 for any three ordered distinct rates, contrary to -v1 v3 d2<=0 in the one-factor model; two repeated groups give a strictly nonzero off-diagonal tetrad. Single exceptional rate admits an explicit nonnegative diagonal remainder, while three-index offdiagonal equations force zero repeated uniqueness. Positive perturbation minors of order t^4 divided by entries order t bound the Frobenius gap below ct^3; midpoint factor upper bounds it Ct^3 for fixed rates. Exact stationary rates (1,2,3) yield Δ=1/240, forced d2=-1/60, bound (sqrt(991)-31)/120. Independent SymPy series and exact Gram computations corroborated; finite checks do not prove the universal statement.
